driver_config:
# Applies on next driver load; no live module reload over SSH.
options r8188eu rtw_power_mgnt=0 rtw_ips_mode=0 rtw_enusbss=0
journal_config:
[Journal]
Storage=persistent
SystemMaxUse=16M
SystemMaxFileSize=4M
RuntimeMaxUse=8M
MaxRetentionSec=2day
SyncIntervalSec=30s
RateLimitIntervalSec=30s
RateLimitBurst=200
